primary_problem: Resource-constrained statistics physical design for a supplied fixed target workload.

claims.claim_text: Executable replay reproduces native PostgreSQL CE inside the supported statistics-sensitive fragment.
claims.scope: PostgreSQL 16.14 base-relation conjunctive restrictions; supported scalar predicates and constant IN/=ANY; MCV, FD, MCV-first consumption, fixed payload and precedence.
claims.safe_wording: Replay matches native PostgreSQL within the explicitly supported statistics-sensitive base-restriction fragment to the reported floating-point tolerances.
claims.forbidden_wording: CE-Replay exactly reproduces all PostgreSQL cardinality estimation.

claims.claim_text: Statistics-set inclusion can be non-monotone for target-workload CE loss.
claims.scope: Empirical witnesses in two fixed workloads and frozen realizations.
claims.safe_wording: Native extended-statistics consumption semantics can make workload CE loss non-monotone in statistics-set inclusion.
claims.forbidden_wording: Extended statistics are always non-monotone or harmful.

claims.claim_text: Selection remains meaningful even when the available budget is nonbinding.
claims.scope: Census all-statistics versus strict subset; DMV identical 50/75/100% solution with unused capacity.
claims.safe_wording: The optimizer can rationally leave capacity unused and reject harmful or unhelpful statistics.
claims.forbidden_wording: More budget always improves the optimized objective.

claims.claim_text: Aggregate ANALYZE cost admits a useful first-order mechanism-aware object-count approximation in the measured environments.
claims.scope: Aggregate recurring ANALYZE latency on one machine, PostgreSQL 16.14, pair MCV/FD objects.
claims.safe_wording: A mechanism-weighted count model is a reproducible first-order maintenance resource proxy in the measured environments.
claims.forbidden_wording: The model precisely predicts every ANALYZE latency or candidate-specific cost.

claims.claim_text: Maintenance-model form transfers, while fitted coefficients are environment and workload specific.
claims.scope: Census FD/MCV ratio 1.449; DMV ratio 1.51321194083715; deployment prediction errors 7.20% and 21.4295%.
claims.safe_wording: Both workloads support the model form, but coefficients must be calibrated for the measured setting.
claims.forbidden_wording: FD generally costs 1.449x or 1.513x MCV in PostgreSQL.

claims.claim_text: Changing the resource model can materially change the chosen physical design.
claims.scope: Direct Census byte-budget versus maintenance-budget comparison at matched modeled cost.
claims.safe_wording: On Census, resource-model alignment materially changed selection and loss.
claims.forbidden_wording: The same effect was directly demonstrated on DMV or is universal.

claims.claim_text: MCV clause consumption changes downstream FD applicability.
claims.safe_wording: MCV-first consumption can suppress or expose FD use, so the mechanisms must be evaluated compositionally.
claims.forbidden_wording: MCV and FD objectives can always be optimized independently.

claims.claim_text: Joint optimization can restore useful FD consumption suppressed by all-statistics or independently chosen designs.
claims.scope: Census selected FDs consumed; DMV all-statistics consumed 0 FD versus optimized 12 and fresh deployed 11 materialized FDs.
claims.safe_wording: Composition-aware subsets restored FD reachability in both workloads.
claims.forbidden_wording: All selected statistics are always materialized and consumed.

claims.claim_text: Semantic dependency information permits exact incremental move evaluation with fewer control replays.
claims.scope: Audited fixed ADD/DROP/SWAP neighborhoods and trajectories; DMV avoided 67.91% of full-workload query replay operations.
claims.safe_wording: Dependency-aware evaluation reduces control-replay work while preserving audited move results.
claims.forbidden_wording: Semantic incremental evaluation always accelerates end-to-end optimization.

claims.claim_text: Sparse affected-query locality is present in Census.
claims.scope: Census pair-candidate mean degree 4.44; giant component prevents strict component decomposition.
claims.safe_wording: Census exhibits sparse local incidence despite a giant connected component.
claims.forbidden_wording: Sparse locality is a universal workload property.

claims.claim_text: The semantic method remains useful on dense candidate/workload incidence.
claims.scope: 36 high-reuse pairs; degree mean 497.13; 67.91% query replay operations avoided.
claims.safe_wording: DMV shows useful exact dependency-aware evaluation in a dense, small candidate universe.

claims.claim_text: Global optimality is established only on exhaustive small/restricted instances; workload-scale results are fixed-neighborhood local optima.
claims.scope: Fixed payload and precedence; deterministic ADD/DROP/SWAP terminal audits; DMV 4/4 restricted exhaustive recovery.
claims.safe_wording: The workload-scale designs are locally optimal under the audited neighborhood.
claims.forbidden_wording: The optimizer finds the global optimum on full Census or DMV.

claims.claim_text: Selected mixed designs can be physically realized and fresh replay can match fresh native estimates.
claims.scope: Exact creation order, one fresh ANALYZE, fresh payload replay/native validation.
claims.safe_wording: Physical realization and fresh semantic fidelity succeeded on both workloads.
claims.forbidden_wording: Both workloads have complete paired frozen-to-fresh numerical drift audits.

claims.claim_text: Fresh ANALYZE may change payload realization and objective.
claims.scope: Census has paired and repeated evidence; DMV lacks frozen per-query numerical provenance.
claims.safe_wording: Census quantifies paired payload drift; DMV shows aggregate and control-path change but cannot provide the paired per-query distribution.
claims.forbidden_wording: DMV has a paired frozen-to-fresh estimate-drift distribution.

claims.claim_text: The replay boundary can be deliberately extended to constant ScalarArray/IN semantics using source-derived rules.
claims.scope: Conjunctive constant IN/=ANY text predicates; 29 synthetic cases, 128 scalar regressions, 1965 DMV queries.
claims.safe_wording: A bounded source-derived ScalarArray extension achieved complete semantic coverage of the canonical DMV file.
claims.forbidden_wording: The system automatically supports arbitrary PostgreSQL predicates.

claims.claim_text: General PostgreSQL CE coverage is not established.
claims.safe_wording: The project replays the supported statistics-sensitive base-restriction CE fragment of PostgreSQL 16.14.
claims.forbidden_wording: The project replays PostgreSQL cardinality estimation without qualification.
